name: Press sideways button on orange wall
description:
the trick is invisible buttons are not counted as being pressed

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 5 ticks after Start. The complete level repeats tick 2 at tick 4, then rolls back to Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (1, 1, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Orange wall, Orange button.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north.
Tick 2: Orange walls moves 1 down; Buttons moves 1 down.
Tick 3: Orange walls moves 1 up; Buttons moves 1 up.
Tick 4: Orange walls moves 1 down; Buttons moves 1 down.
Tick 5: Orange walls moves 1 up; Buttons moves 1 up; Player moves 1 south.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
